speaker: Doctor
text:
The MRI findings of disseminated white matter lesions in an HIV-positive patient with non-compliance strongly suggest HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder or an opportunistic infection like PML. I will request a lumbar puncture to analyze the cerebrospinal fluid for HIV viral load and JC virus PCR to confirm the diagnosis.

REQUEST TEST: Lumbar_Puncture

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal lumbar puncture makes an active opportunistic infection like PML or encephalitis much less likely, pointing instead toward HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder or another chronic process. Do you have any history of intravenous drug use, or have you experienced any recent significant weight loss or night sweats?

text: The somnolence and confusion suggest significant central nervous system involvement, possibly due to opportunistic infections like toxoplasmosis or lymphoma despite the initial normal LP, or advanced HIV encephalopathy. REQUEST TEST: HIV_Viral_Load

speaker: Doctor
text: The extremely high viral load confirms uncontrolled HIV infection, which, combined with the disseminated white matter lesions and cognitive decline, points to HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder. DIAGNOSIS READY: HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder
